# Import list of viostor.sys, extracted from the real signed driver with
# tools/ci/check-driver-imports.py --dump (do not edit by hand).  The
# import-coverage check (the same tool) verifies every ntoskrnl.exe and
# hal.dll import below is provided by kernel/nt/exports.h; wdfldr.sys
# imports are the KMDF loader's own exports, provided by a later driver
# step (30.4/30.5), and are allow-listed there.

ntoskrnl.exe	KeBugCheck
ntoskrnl.exe	KeGetCurrentIrql
ntoskrnl.exe	KeQueryActiveProcessorCountEx
ntoskrnl.exe	KeQueryMaximumProcessorCountEx
ntoskrnl.exe	MmGetPhysicalAddress
storport.sys	StorPortBusy

storport.sys	StorPortGetDeviceBase
storport.sys	StorPortGetPhysicalAddress
